item.title: [Due in 2 days] Teams consolidates GitHub Notifications and GitHub Copilot into one GitHub app; the legacy app is deprecated by 16 November 2026
item.description:
A new third-party app identity replaces the old one, so an app permission policy that allowed the legacy GitHub app does not automatically cover the new one, and its consent must be reviewed like any new app.

Teams · deadline 2026-11-16 · Check the Teams app permission policies and the Entra consent granted to the new GitHub app before 16 November, and remove the legacy app from allow lists afterwards.

item.title: [Message Center] MC1552394 Microsoft Viva Engage: Retirement of Teams town hall event creation
item.description:
Starting December 7, 2026, users cannot create Teams town hall events from Viva Engage; previously scheduled events will continue. Organizers must use the new Events experience in Viva Engage or Microsoft Teams. Organizations should inform teams and update documentation accordingly before this date.

Microsoft Viva · Plan for Change · act by 2026-12-07

item.title: [Message Center] MC1552392 Microsoft Teams: Automatic recording indicator for call queue calls on Mobile
item.description:
Microsoft Teams on Mobile will show a clear banner indicating automatic, uninterruptible recording and transcription of call queue calls by the organization. This update, rolling out worldwide in December 2026, aligns mobile with desktop and requires no admin action, though informing calling reps is recommended.

Microsoft Teams · Stay Informed

item.title: [Message Center] MC1552391 Microsoft Teams: Copilot in the Queues app on Mobile
item.description:
Microsoft Teams is introducing Copilot in the Queues app on Mobile, allowing reps and supervisors to ask questions about recorded calls for quick insights. Rolling out worldwide from late November to mid-December 2026, it requires Teams Premium and Microsoft 365 Copilot licenses, with no admin action needed before rollout.

Microsoft Teams · Stay Informed

item.title: [Message Center] MC1552390 Microsoft Teams: Manage call groups on Mobile
item.description:
Microsoft Teams will allow users to create and manage call groups directly on Mobile, enabling call forwarding and ring settings without desktop access. This feature, rolling out worldwide in December 2026, requires a Teams Phone license and enabled calling policy, with no admin action needed before rollout.

Microsoft Teams · Stay Informed

item.title: [Message Center] MC1550542 Microsoft Teams: Updated recording and transcript access setting behavior for town halls and webinars
item.description:
Microsoft Teams is updating the "Who has access to the recording or transcript" option for Events App town halls and webinars. It will depend on the RecordingForTownhall or RecordingForWebinar settings instead of AllowCloudRecording. The change rolls out worldwide in early to mid-November 2026 with no action required.

item.title: [Message Center] MC1546409 Microsoft Teams: Retirement of off-network invitations to Teams Free
item.description:
Microsoft Teams will retire off-network invitations for Teams Free accounts starting December 2026. Users can no longer invite external people via email or chat links to create Teams Free accounts. Existing Teams Free collaboration and federation remain unchanged. No admin action is needed, but user guidance should be updated.
